items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: we got together and formed the Harlem Ampets. Well, who was in that group? Well, myself on trumpet, little Horace Malcolm, Horace Malcolm on piano

ctx.x: Did you ever play any of those bands or did you form your own first?

Well, it's like I said, we got together and formed the Harlem Ampets. Well, who was in that group? Well, myself on trumpet, little Horace Malcolm, Horace Malcolm on piano, Odell Rand on clarinet. He played an E-flat clarinet. He was a little short fellow with a little short clarinet. And Joe McCoy on guitar. His brother Charlie McCoy, he played a mandolin. Mandolin on guitar, whatever you call it. I think it's, it's 12 strings on it. He played a band. We had different drummers. P.C. Williams was one. And John…
Were those all New Orleans men or were there many from Chicago?
